summary: Heroes of the Storm entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Heroes of the Storm
entries.definitive_edition: Current Battle.net live PC client with exact patch/account/server state documented

primary.why: Heroes of the Storm remains playable through Blizzard's live client, but since Blizzard's 2022 support update the game is a long-running live-service archive target focused on seasonal rolls, rotations, bug fixes, and balance changes rather than new for-purchase content. The current PC client is the capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Battle.net PC client. Record build/date, region, account/heroes unlocked, game mode, map, party/AI state, balance patch, shop/rotation state, and whether macOS was compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only if documenting Mac compatibility/performance.
secondary.why: Windows PC is the stronger capture and support route.

secondary.exclusive_content: Retired hero balance, battleground rotations, cosmetics, and esports-era state
secondary.what_to_play: Document from dated patch notes/captures only.
secondary.why: The current client does not preserve every past live-service state.

all_releases.fidelity: Seasonal rolls, hero rotations, shop operation, client sustainability, bug fixes, and balance updates as needed.
all_releases.reason: primary: current service model defines archive caveats.

all_releases.fidelity: Current balance and bug-fix patch state.
all_releases.reason: primary: record exact patch before any run.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Live-service completeness depends on account unlocks, region, current balance patch, hero rotation, maps, and server state.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record patch and rotation state. Do not present retired esports-era or old seasonal states as current.
